def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 5]
    if not cells:
        return out
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)

    depth = 1
    while r0 + depth <= r1 - depth and c0 + depth <= c1 - depth:
        color = 2 if depth % 2 == 1 else 5
        top, bottom = r0 + depth, r1 - depth
        left, right = c0 + depth, c1 - depth
        for c in range(left, right + 1):
            out[top][c] = out[bottom][c] = color
        for r in range(top, bottom + 1):
            out[r][left] = out[r][right] = color
        depth += 1
    return out
